name: first-class-sessions
description: Create one indexed PostgreSQL row per authentication session and migrate held-schema keyed session documents without retaining plaintext bearer tokens.
statements: CREATE TABLE casino_sessions (session_id VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL, token_digest CHAR(64) NOT NULL, user_id VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, expires_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, generation BIGINT NOT NULL, session_json JSONB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (session_id), CONSTRAINT uq_casino_sessions_token_digest UNIQUE (token_digest), CONSTRAINT chk_casino_sessions_token_digest CHECK (token_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'), CONSTRAINT chk_casino_sessions_status CHECK (status IN ('active', 'revoked')), CONSTRAINT chk_casino_sessions_generation CHECK (generation BETWEEN 1 AND 9223372036854775807), CONSTRAINT chk_casino_sessions_payload CHECK (jsonb_typeof(session_json) = 'object' AND session_json->>'session_id' = session_id AND session_json->>'token_digest' = token_digest AND session_json->>'user_id' = user_id AND session_json->>'status' = status AND session_json->>'updated_at' = updated_at AND session_json->>'expires_at' = expires_at AND CASE WHEN session_json->>'generation' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,18}$' THEN (session_json->>'generation')::NUMERIC = generation ELSE FALSE END))
CREATE INDEX idx_casino_sessions_user_activity ON casino_sessions (user_id, status, updated_at, session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_casino_sessions_expiry ON casino_sessions (status, expires_at, session_id)

INSERT INTO casino_sessions (session_id, token_digest, user_id, status, created_at, updated_at, expires_at, generation, session_json) SELECT payload_json->>'session_id', payload_json->>'token_digest', payload_json->>'user_id', payload_json->>'status', payload_json->>'created_at', payload_json->>'updated_at', payload_json->>'expires_at', (payload_json->>'generation')::BIGINT, payload_json FROM casino_documents WHERE document_key LIKE 'auth/session/v2/row/%' ORDER BY document_key
DELETE FROM casino_documents WHERE document_key LIKE 'auth/session/v2/row/%'
